title: Concept: Resource hint pointing at plaintext HTTP
description: A preconnect or prefetch link that targets a plaintext host in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The hint makes the browser open the connection before anything is needed, so the insecure origin is contacted even if the resource is never used.
applicability: Deployments that render a preconnect or prefetch link that targets a plaintext host into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The hint makes the browser open the connection before anything is needed, so the insecure origin is contacted even if the resource is never used.
